messages:
mira: kicking off canary for model v4.0-int8 at 5% traffic. goal: validate latency, hallucination rate, and rerank precision. running 30m min.

sam: baseline (v3.3 float32) p95=115ms, p50=40ms, halluc_rate=0.55%, rerank_p@1=0.874

devon: initial smoke shows p95 ~140ms and halluc ~1.4% on a 200-sample longdoc slice. looks worse for long context.

mira: noted. we did not enable kv_warmup for that run — cold kv could explain longdocs. starting second canary with kv_warmup=true and model.kv_init=preload.

jordan: small ask: add an A/B for rerank on the same traffic slice (shadow rerank + live compare). we need delta P@1 with CI.

eva: product note — if rerank P@1 drops more than 0.8% absolute we should auto-abort. customers see ranking regressions quickly.

ops-bot: Canary update at 2025-11-03T15:12:00Z: traffic=5% -> 7% (auto-increase), duration=18m so far.

sam: propose auto-fallback rule: abort if ANY of:
- halluc_rate_increase_abs > 0.6%
- p95_rel > 1.25 AND p50_rel > 1.15
- rerank_p@1_abs_drop > 0.8%
plus at least 10m sustained over smoothing window 5m.

devon: add guard: require >=1000 requests in the evaluation window for statistical significance.

mira: new canary run with kv warmup shows p95=122ms, halluc=0.7%, rerank_p@1=0.868 (delta -0.6%). that's borderline but within Sam/Eva thresholds?

eva: -0.6% is below abort but still concerning. can we run additional longdoc-focused shadow sample for 20m?

jordan: yeah, schedule targeted slice at 10% of canary traffic for longdoc cases. also enable token_prefix_cache to reduce cold p95.

mira: updating rollout config (applied):
```
canary:
  traffic: 0.05
  min_duration_mins: 20
  metrics:
    - name: p95_latency_ms
      threshold_rel: 1.25
    - name: hallucination_rate
      threshold_abs: 0.006 # 0.6%
    - name: rerank_p1
      threshold_abs_drop: 0.008 # 0.8%
  smoothing_window_mins: 5
  min_requests: 1000
  kv_warmup: true
  targeted_slices: [longdoc, fewshot, rerank-heavy]
  auto_fallback: true
```

sam: looks good. also add fallback path: roll back to v3.3-float32 and route affected slices to dedicated fallback model until next safe promote.

devon: FYI observed an intermittent spike in error_rate (5xx) at t+12m from a node — was transient; ops-bot logs show OOM from a worker then recovered. not part of model perf but affects canary signals.

ops-bot: Alert suppressed (oom-worker-17) at 2025-11-03T15:20:22Z — node auto-restarted.

mira: because of the OOM noise, we'll wait full 30m before making a promote decision and ensure smoothing excludes that 2m spike.

jordan: post-canary plan: if canary passes, promote to 25% with a 1h hold, metric checks every 10m, then gradual 2x traffic increases with rollback triggers.

eva: add runbook step: if rerank degradation is detected after promote, toggle shadow-rerank-only mode and reduce traffic to 1% while we investigate.

sam: agree. will open follow-up ticket to capture the exact CI computation and telemetry tags.

mira: thanks all — will post final canary summary + time series after 30m. :thumbsup:
